 Anne Hathaway’s new baby’s sex accidentally revealed by ‘Devil Wears Prada 2’ costume designer 
 By 
 Riley Cardoza 
 Published 
 Nov. 18, 2026, 9:15 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Anne Hathaway’s third child is a baby girl, according to a “Devil Wears Prada 2” costume designer.
 Molly Rogers spilled the beans in an Instagram Story on Tuesday by referring to the actress’ newborn daughter.
 “Congrats are in order for proud mama @annehathaway & her new addition to the family … a baby girl!” the Emmy winner wrote.
 8 
 Anne Hathaway (pictured arriving at “The End Of Oak Street” premiere at Warner Bros. Studios in Burbank, California, Sunday, Aug. 9, 2026) has welcomed a baby girl. Getty Images for Warner Brothers Pictures 
 8 
 “Devil Wears Prada 2” costume designer Molly Rogers made the reveal via Instagram Stories on Tuesday. mollyrogerscostumes/Instagram

 Rogers’ headline-making social media upload included a photo of a teddy bear in a patchwork dress and a hat.
 Hathaway has yet to post about her new arrival on social media — and her rep did not immediately respond to Page Six’s request for comment.
 News broke Tuesday that the “Verity” star, 44, had given birth to baby No. 3 with her husband, Adam Shulman .

 “Congrats are in order for proud mama @annehathaway & her new addition to the family … a baby girl!” the Emmy winner, pictured at the Variety High Tea Celebrating the Women of Awards Season in Nov. 16, 2026) wrote. Variety via Getty Images

 She was photographed on a stroll in New York City with a baby strapped to her chest.
 While the little one was not visible, a maroon beanie topped with a pink pom-pom poked out from the top of the brown carrier.
 The Golden Globe winner, for her part, cut a casual figure in an oversized coat, sweats and a baseball cap.
 8 
 The actress (pictured at “The Drew Barrymore Show” in Midtown Manhattan, New York, Wednesday, Sept. 30, 2026) was spotted in New York City with a baby carrier strapped to her chest. GC Images 
 8 
 Hathaway went public with her pregnancy news in June. annehathaway/Instagram 
 Hathaway announced in June that she w as expecting , posting a baby bump photo via Instagram after stepping out in a bikini on a St. Tropez vacation.
 “x Baby, I’m yours x,” the “Odyssey” star captioned the reveal at the time.
 She and Shulman, 45, are also the parents of sons Jonathan and Jack , born in 2016 and 2019, respectively.
 8 
 The Oscar winner (pictured arriving at the BVLGARI “Serpenti Infinito” Celebration at BOOM in New York on Wednesday, Sept. 9, 2026) shares two sons with husband Adam Shulman. Variety via Getty Images 
 8 
 Hathaway (pictured walking in New York City on Tuesday, June 30, 2026) welcomed Jonathan and Jack in 2016 and 2019, respectively. GC Images 
 In August, Hathaway was asked at an event whether she had a boy or girl on the way — to which she replied, “Oh, be patient.”
 The Oscar winner gestured to her budding belly at the time and quipped, “You’re gonna find out in five minutes.
 “Thank you for the support,” she added when her response was applauded. “I always feel so rude saying that. I feel so bad.”
